scripts.test: npm run test:golden && npm run test:random
scripts.test:golden:system: NODE_ENV=test ALLOW_GOLDEN_DB_RESET=true NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --selectProjects golden --runInBand golden/tests/5 golden/tests/6
scripts.test:golden:remote: NODE_ENV=test ALLOW_GOLDEN_DB_RESET=true NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --selectProjects golden --runInBand golden/tests/0 golden/tests/5
scripts.test:golden:drafts: GOLDEN_INCLUDE_DRAFTS=true NODE_ENV=test ALLOW_GOLDEN_DB_RESET=true NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --selectProjects golden --runInBand
